verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an AI assistant product like Microsoft Copilot, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only web, mobile, Office-app, Edge browser and connector surfaces, and never mentions a command-line interface. The probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI all returned 404, and none of them speaks to a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
